newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Bondes rate rises slightly at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Bondes rate rises slightly at auction.

text.p: The rate on Mexican government 728-day development bonds, or Bondes, rose 0.08 percentage points to 1.47 percent above the one-month Cetes rate in Tuesday's primary auction, dealers estimated.
Demand for the Bondes was 3.85 billion pesos compared to the 500 million offered by Banco de Mexico. They were assigned at an average price of 97.66904 pesos.

Last week the rate on 728-day Bondes fell 0.03 percentage points to 1.39 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate and were assigned at a price of 97.79028 pesos on demand of 1.655 billion pesos compared to the 500 million offered by Banco de Mexico. -- Mexico City newsroom +525 728-9559
